label: Connect a bounded set of actual foreign-language spoken expressions with their meanings
definition: Hear or access each actual target expression, match it to the supplied meaning and contrast it with the changed item/status expression. Request clarification on an unfamiliar expression rather than infer meaning from tone or gesture alone. Record the selected language, actual expressions/meanings and listening/access support; a written card or partner translation alone is not target-language listening evidence.
source: Capability Atlas individually authored profession pathways v1

assessment.method: Observe the authored task and changed case; record support, actual result, errors and feedback.
criteria: Connects actual selected foreign-language expressions with their supplied meanings
Distinguishes changed item/status expressions rather than memorised order
Retains unknown meaning and actual listening/access support

evidence_basis: Individually authored Atlas proposal. Source facets are mapped in the profession route; no external practitioner review, learner observation or occupational certification is claimed.
input_specification: A language practitioner identifies an actual target language foreign to this learner and the agreed speech or speech-generating AAC access. For a learner for whom English is foreign, actual voiced examples are accepted, held, item A and item B, linked to harmless actual item/status props and accessible meanings. Present one contrasting pair at a time, then revisit in changed combinations. A proficient speaker supplies/validates the target pronunciation, meaning and alternatives; if English is already familiar, another actual foreign language must have its own explicitly taught expressions, not a renamed completion record.
output_specification: Connects actual selected foreign-language expressions with their supplied meanings; Distinguishes changed item/status expressions rather than memorised order; Retains unknown meaning and actual listening/access support

focus.goal: A spoken expression in a selected foreign language refers to an actual meaning that must be distinguished from a similar or contrasting expression.
new_concepts: A spoken expression in a selected foreign language refers to an actual meaning that must be distinguished from a similar or contrasting expression.

starting_abilities.ability: Keep actual referents and agreed usable access clear.
alternatives: Provide accessible objects, diagrams, labels or an agreed partner description.
Record physical, communication and answer support separately; assisted performance does not establish unaided competence.

understanding_check.what_changes: Held replaces accepted while the item remains A.
understanding_check.materials: Actual proficient-speaker voiced item A is held versus item A is accepted and separate A status props.
understanding_check.prompt: Identify which actual meaning the changed expression communicates.
expected_evidence: Held is not interpreted as accepted from the earlier pattern.
Unknown hearing/meaning is clarified rather than guessed.
understanding_check.evidence_scope: Record the changed case, result and support used. A supplied-case result does not establish general or independent mastery.

difficulties.misconception: Using a familiar gesture, written translation or previous response as evidence of understanding new spoken words.
